llmAsAJudge.instructions: You are a football tactics judge. Given the game state the agent received and the single command it returned, rate whether the command was a sound tactical decision for that player's role (goalkeeper, defender, midfielder or forward): did it shoot only when close to goal with the ball, pass to a better-placed teammate, press when the opponent had the ball nearby, and keep its position otherwise? Context: {context} Agent output: {assistant_turn}

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: The command was invalid, impossible (e.g. shooting without the ball) or clearly harmful for the team.

numerical.label: Acceptable
numerical.definition: The command was legal and reasonable but a clearly better option was available.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: The command was the right tactical choice for the role and situation.
